primary_sources.title: MDIC/Embrapii/GIZ-IKI call for steel and cement decarbonization projects
primary_sources.facts: Up to R$81m non-repayable resources; 15 proposed innovation projects; applications through Embrapii coordinating unit due 29 Jan 2027; results 12 Apr 2027; projects up to 30 months.

primary_sources.title: ANEEL Transmission Auction 4/2026 result
primary_sources.facts: 8 lots awarded; approx. R$8.8bn investment; 1,866 km new lines; 12,694 MVA transformation; 50.10% discount; operation deadlines 42–60 months.

primary_sources.title: ANEEL 1/2027 transmission auction pipeline
primary_sources.facts: Planned 30 Apr 2027 auction: 12 lots, 3,245 km new lines, 1,386 MVA, 13 states; TCU submission expected Dec 2026.

primary_sources.title: USTR Section 301 determinations and proposed actions
primary_sources.facts: Formal determinations and proposed actions for 14 economies; public comments due 5 Jan 2027 and hearings from 25 Jan; tariffs are proposed, not effective.

hypotheses.mechanism: A non-repayable R&D/industrial-demonstration call can lower early validation costs for steel/cement decarbonization technologies and connect research to plant-level trials.
hypotheses.observed_evidence: MDIC reports up to R$81m, 15 proposals, non-repayable IKI/Embrapii resources plus company counterpart; application deadline 29 Jan 2027, result 12 Apr 2027, project duration up to 30 months.
validation_gaps: Eligible applicants and matching requirements for each call lot
Actual submitted/selected projects and award values
Plant-level baseline emissions, energy use and output
Technology readiness, capex, operating cost, permits and scale-up pathway
Measured emissions reduction and productivity after demonstration
hypotheses.falsifier: No eligible plant/project can meet counterpart and technical requirements; awards do not yield validated industrial deployment or measurable emissions/productivity gains.

hypotheses.mechanism: Awarded and planned transmission capacity may reduce a grid-access bottleneck for generation and electricity-intensive production over multi-year construction horizons.
hypotheses.observed_evidence: ANEEL/EPE auction 4/2026 awarded 8 lots, about R$8.88bn, 1,866 km new lines and 12,694 MVA, with 42–60 month operation deadlines; 1/2027 pipeline lists 12 lots, 3,245 km and 1,386 MVA, planned for 30 Apr 2027.
validation_gaps: Contract signatures, milestones and actual construction progress
Local demand, connection rights and tariff/curtailment exposure
Financing close, permits and commissioned capacity
hypotheses.falsifier: Projects are delayed/cancelled or new capacity is not available at the relevant nodes when demand arrives.

hypotheses.mechanism: Proposed duties may change supplier selection, inventory, assembly location and investment timing in covered product chains; firms could reroute sourcing or localize production if final tariff incidence is durable.
hypotheses.observed_evidence: USTR published determinations/proposed actions for 14 economies on 25 Nov; comments due 5 Jan 2027 and hearings from 25 Jan. Measures remain proposed, not effective.
validation_gaps: Final product-level coverage, exclusions and effective dates
Customs data by product/origin after implementation
Announced/committed capex, plant permits and production start
Actual landed-cost changes and trade diversion rather than transshipment
hypotheses.falsifier: Final measures are narrowed/delayed, landed-cost changes are negligible, or no realized sourcing/capex/production shift is observed.
